cards.card_text: Next comes a message for Shemaiah the Nehelamite, a man who's been working the mail like it's his second job.
cards.verse_text: You are to tell Shemaiah the Nehelamite that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “In your own name you have sent out letters to all the people of Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and to all the priests.
cards.snippet: You are to tell Shemaiah the Nehelamite that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel,…

cards.card_text: Then the word of the LORD comes to Jeremiah: send all the exiles a message about Shemaiah the Nehelamite.
cards.verse_text: (Zephaniah the priest, however, had read this letter to Jeremiah the prophet.) Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah: “Send a message telling all the exiles what the LORD says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite.
cards.snippet: …message telling all the exiles what the LORD says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite.

cards.card_text: The LORD says He will surely punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants.
cards.verse_text: this is what the LORD says: ‘I will surely punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants.
